card.title: 139. GEBIRGSJÄGER
card.text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ when you add or deploy an Alpine unit.
card.flavorText: The 139th Gebirgsjäger Regiment was a unit of the 3rd Mountain Division of the Wehrmacht, raised from the Austrian Army following the Anschluss, the German annexation of Austria, in 1938. The division participated in the Invasion of Poland in 1939 as part of Army Group South but was later redeployed to garrison the Siegfried Line before the campaign ended. In 1940 the 139th Gebirgjäger Regiment was sent to Northern Norway to secure the Arctic port of Narvik, but there they faced heavy resistance from the Allies, and were on the brink of surrendering when the Allies decided to abandon Narvik due to the German invasion of France. In 1941 the regiment rejoined the 3rd Mountain Division and moved into Lapland to participate in Operation Silver Fox, which was an attack on the Soviet Arctic aimed at capturing Murmansk. The operation failed to achieve its main objectives and in 1942 the division was sent to the Eastern Front. There it engaged in combat near the town of Velikiye Luki, and then moved south to help in relieving Stalingrad. Following the German defeat at Stalingrad, the division fought in the southern theaters of the Eastern Front, retreating through Ukraine, Hungary, Slovakia, and eventually surrendering to the Red Army in Silesia when the war ended in 1945.
